name: GIFT
overview:
The lonely genius astrophysicist, Go Tetsu, encountered

a struggling ‘wheelchair rugby’ team.

There he found a group of unique players, each with their own disabilities—

What does it mean to live? What does it mean to fight? What does victory mean?

To all those who have lived in the darkness,

this is the story of a ‘gift’

called ‘love’, bestowed by God—
